sentences.text: 15. PW-4, PW-5 and PW-6 are the police officials who have deposed regarding the Investigation leading upto filing of chargesheet.
The complainant Sri Amthony Manual was examined as PW-5.

During his chief examination, he has deposed that the accused had approached for a loan in the year 2008 and his predecessor Manager had sanctioned Rs.30 lakhs each to the accused for Poultry business.
The accused has mortgaged property at the time of sanctioning of loan.
The loan was sanctioned in the year, 2008 and it become Non performing assent in the year, 2009.
accordingly, they had filed proceeding before Debt Recovery Tribunal which came to be decreed in their favour.
The decree was no executed as the title document produced by the accused were fake document.
Later when their bank officials went to Sub-Registrar office to verify the genuineness of document, they came to know the document were fake.
Hence, he had also filed a private complaint as per Ex.P.-5.
During his cross examination, he admits that in order to know whether borrower had taken loan or not, they have to take signatures of borrower on the loan sanction letter.
He admits that without looking a sanction letter, it cannot be aid that borrower had accepted the loan or not.
He admits that he had not submitted Account Extracts at the time of filing of complaint.

He admits that he had not submitted any document to Manuel vs T Rajanna on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58001994/

The above being materials on record it would be appropriate to see whether the prosecution proves its case beyond reasonable doubt.
18. On going through entire case of prosecution, it can be seen that the whole case of prosecution revolves around Partition Deed dated 5-12-2006 or the prosecution states fake one.
The first and foremost aspect are the proceeding has to prove the Partition Deed being a fabricated document.
19. The prosecution has produced copy of Partition Deed dated 05-12-2006 as ExP.6.
It has to be stated that at the time of marking of the document, it is also objected regarding marking of xerox copy.
It has come in the evidence that the original Partition Deed is in the custody of bank.
The bank have neither submitted the original Partition Deed to the Court nor they have handed over the original partition Deed to the I.O. in order to get the document examined during investigation.
Mere production of xerox copy in  12  C.C.No.23096/2014 the absence of original document makes the xerox copy inadmissible in the evidence.

Hence, this court cannot rely on Manuel vs T Rajanna on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58001994/
9 inadmissible document which is Ex.P.6.
 20. PW-3 who is the person who had given his opinion regarding the genuineness of Ex.P.6 document as deposed in his cross examination that he had not received original partition Deed for his verification in the Sub-Registrar office.
When a person who has entrusted with a specific job by the bank, then in order to get a clear picture all the relevant document have to be handed over to such person.
In this case, going by deposition of PW-3, it can be seen that PW-3 has prepared a report without having the original document in his custody for his reference.
Hence, the report submitted by PW-3 are also the evidence of PW-3 cannot be looked into as it is not reliable to prove the guilt of the accused.

21 . It is interesting to note that PW-2 during his cross examination admits that before giving his legal report he had gone to the Sub-Registrar office and verified the document given to him in the office of Sub-Registrar and found all the document to be correct.
PW-2 specifically states that he had also examined the  13  C.C.No.23096/2014 partition deed and he did not find any mismatch with document present in the office of sub-Registrar.
Such being the case, there is clear contradictory version regarding partition deed wherein, PW-2 states the document to be genuine document and PW-3 states the partition deed to be a fake document.

Hence, for the above discussion, I hold that even if the evidence of PW-2 does not hold,
the prosecution to prove its case.

10  22.
Now coming to the evidence of PW-1 and PW-5 is concerned, this court is of the view that their evidence is only based on report of PW 2 and 3.
The prosecution in the above paras the evidence of Pws. 2 and 3 by themselves are self contradictory.
Such being the case, on the basis of evidence of Pws. 1 and 2 itself is unreliable, then the evidence of Pws.1 and 2 cannot be relied to prove the case of prosecution.
23. Other than the report of PW-3 in this case, the I.O. not done any separate investigation to show that partition deed produced by the accused was a concocted document.
On the base of scar also case of prosecution falls like a pack card.
24. On going through all the above discussion, this court is of the view that prosecution has failed to prove that accused had  14  C.C.No.23096/2014 obtained loan based on fake document.
Accordingly, this court has held that the prosecution has failed to prove its case beyond all reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
